title: New York city location required.
officialText:
Except as otherwise noted for a particular license, the holder of a license, other than
an employee of a city agency, shall have or be employed by a business entity that has an established place of business with an
address within the city of New York at which such person can be contacted by the public and the department by mail, telephone or
other modes of communication. A post office box is not an acceptable address.
